FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What dental services are offered at the North Myrtle Beach, SC, office?

We provide all the necessary dental services such as routine cleanings and exams, fillings, pediatric dental procedures, gum contouring, fluoride treatment, and so much more!

How do I schedule an appointment with a dentist in North Myrtle Beach, SC?

To schedule a visit, feel free to call us or book an appointment online to get you in as soon as possible! We look forward to treating you and providing you with the comfort and care you deserve!

‍

Is same-day emergency dental care available at your North Myrtle Beach office?

Yes. At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our North Myrtle Beach location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

Do you offer cosmetic treatments like teeth whitening, veneers, or Invisalign®?

Yes, we understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include whitening, veneers, and Invisalign®.

Can I get dental implants or implant consultations in North Myrtle Beach, SC?

Yes. Our team of experts is here to help you with all your dental issues, including implants. You can schedule an appointment or request a consultation to make sure you’re getting the best treatment suited available.

Do you provide pediatric or family dental care in North Myrtle Beach, SC?

Absolutely. We recognize the importance of starting dental care as early as possible and make sure to provide kids and adults with pediatric or orthodontic care most comfortably and comprehensively as they deserve.

What diagnosis technologies, like digital X-rays or imaging, are used in North Myrtle Beach?

Digital X-rays use a small sensor and X-ray film tabs, and can provide two types of images: intraoral, for inside the mouth, and extraoral, for outside the mouth. Bitewing X-rays are the most commonly used intraoral X-rays; for extraoral X-rays, the panoramic X-ray is the most common. With this type, you stand still while a machine rotates around your head and takes a single image of your entire mouth.

Where is the North Myrtle Beach dental office located, and what are its hours?

Our North Myrtle Beach office is located at 900 Hwy 17 S, Suite E, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582. Our office Hours are Monday-Thursday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Friday: 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM. We are closed on Saturday and Sunday. We look forward to seeing you!

What comfort or sedation options are available here (e.g., for anxious patients)?

At North Myrtle Beach, we offer a variety of sedation dentistry options. You can choose from Nitrous Oxide, IV Sedation, and Local Anesthesia

Do you accept insurance or offer membership or financing plans in North Myrtle Beach, SC?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Before any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.
